## Draft Role

This assignment is the first serious dynamic-programming proof and implementation.

## Planned Sections

1. Define the Needleman-Wunsch recurrence.
2. Fill a small DP table by hand.
3. Prove correctness with an optimal-substructure argument.
4. Implement score-table construction and traceback.
5. Verify empty-string, one-character, and tie cases.
6. Compare two scoring systems.
7. AI/tool disclosure and failure-mode reflection.
